answer: Resist sybils with capital-recycling friction: each identity's stake enters an exit queue and can only be withdrawn after a long delay, like water slowly crossing a glacier. An attacker cannot reuse the same funds to spin up fake after fake, because each sybil ties up fresh capital for the full queue. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand separately locked stakes, a prism of frozen capital no single pool can refract into many names. Honest agents lock once in the oasis of standing, while forgery becomes linear capital cost.
